1_structure.question: What is the current Services page structure?
1_structure.answer: Static content (hardcoded JSX components in `app/service/page.tsx` and `components/Services.tsx`).

2_storage.question: How are services stored?
2_storage.answer: They are not stored in any external or internal data structure. The code is entirely hardcoded in the templates.

3_categories.question: Current main service categories - list all.

4_life_insurance.question: Under 'Life Insurance' what items are currently shown?
4_life_insurance.answer: Only a short description text. LIC is NOT present. There are no providers or plans listed.

5_health_insurance.question: Under 'Health Insurance' what items are currently shown?
5_health_insurance.answer: Only a short description text. Galaxy is NOT present. There are no providers, plans, or categories listed.

6_hierarchy.question: Is there a 3rd level hierarchy? If yes, show the structure.
6_hierarchy.answer: No. It is a flat, single-level list of generic service cards.

7_dynamic_details.question: Are service detail pages dynamic?
7_dynamic_details.answer: No. Service detail pages do not exist. The 'Read More' links present on the cards currently point to empty hrefs (`href=""`).

8_reusable_component.question: Is there a reusable service detail component?

9_routing.question: How is routing handled?
9_routing.answer: Simple static Next.js App Router routing. The `/service` path maps directly to `app/service/page.tsx`. There is no dynamic routing parameter configured (e.g., no `[slug]`).

10_cms_editable.question: Is the content editable from an admin panel / CMS?
10_cms_editable.answer: No. There is no CMS or admin panel connected; it is directly hardcoded into the source code.

11_service_features_support.question: Do services support feature list, benefits, FAQ, CTA form?
11_service_features_support.note: They only support a simple icon, title, description, and an empty 'Read More' button.

12_data_model_separation.question: Are providers and plans already separated in the data model?
12_data_model_separation.answer: No, because there is no data model at all (everything is in one flat visual list inside JSX).

13_json_data_object.question: Is there an existing JSON/data object for services?

14_ui_layout.question: Is the UI card-based, tab-based, or accordion-based?

15_nested_structure_recommendation.question: Should new insurance content follow the same layout, or can we introduce a nested structure?
15_nested_structure_recommendation.answer: Since the current layout is extremely basic with no dynamic capabilities or data architecture, it is highly recommended to build a new nested structure (e.g., Service -> Provider -> Plan) and implement dynamic routing to support scaling the website's content.
